title: Primus Decision request
description: One request answers every question in `questions` about one `state`. Questions are identified by workflow and question id; the released model answers the 20 benchmark schemas listed under `schemas` in model/member0/config.json and rejects any other (workflow, qid) pair.

workflow.description: workflow name, e.g. invoice_processing; null or absent means the empty workflow

state.description: the JSON state the questions are about; a string is used as raw text

calibrated.description: apply the temperature profile in model/calibration.json; off by default

instructions.description: the question text shown to the model as a bag of words

anyOf.description: choice: option key → option text, in the order the options are scored; noul: optional {"false": text, "true": text}
score: one text per level, level 0 first

criteria.description: null for noul (options are false/true); an object for choice; an array for score
